title: Import the real childAwareText instead of re-implementing it inline in epic_18_track_overhaul_test.dart

evidence.quote: // Import the helper function indirectly by testing its logic

why: The real, public childAwareText already lives at onboarding_screen.dart:32 and is already correctly imported and tested by test/features/onboarding/presentation/screens/onboarding_screen_test.dart and onboarding_bulk_l1_test.dart. This third copy defines its own private closure with the same logic and asserts against that closure. If a future story changes the real substitution rule, this AC-2/AC-3 'story acceptance' test keeps passing against its own frozen copy — a false-green regression gate on exactly the behavior it claims to verify.
recommendation: Delete the inline closure; import childAwareText from onboarding_screen.dart and assert against it directly, as the two feature-level tests already do.
acceptance_criteria: Test imports and calls the real onboarding_screen.dart childAwareText instead of a local reimplementation
